name: halal-restaurant-finder
description: Halal restaurant finder with confidence scores

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.migrate: PGPASSWORD=password psql -h localhost -U postgres -d yelp -f server/DB/db.sql
scripts.score:all: cd server && node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const db=require('./db'); const {updateRestaurantHalalScore}=require('./services/halalScore'); (async()=>{const r=await db.query('SELECT id FROM restaurants'); for(const row of r.rows) await updateRestaurantHalalScore(db,row.id); console.log('Done:',r.rows.length,'restaurants scored'); process.exit(0);})();"
